items.title: Babe Stovall Interview, 1974-04-16
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Jack Friedman' to check if the recording is picking up the interviewee's voice, but the interviewee does not respond with any personal connection or recognition of Jack Friedman.

ctx.x: No, it's... Is that what we're doing?

Yeah, it's 1019 North Billeries, I remember. Right. Yeah, 1019. Oh, yeah. Between Dumaine, no, between St. Philip and Ursuline. Right. And we're right near the school, you told me. Right. And, uh, you know the day's date? It's April or what? Twent, no. No. 16th, huh. 1974. Right. Let's get your name back, too. Jack Friedman. Say it again. I want to see if it's picking up your voice. Okay.
